title: Limitations on backing

subsections.1: back only with reasonable safety and without interfering with other traffic
subsections.2: no backing into an intersection, on or over a crosswalk, or around a street corner
subsections.3: yield in every case to moving traffic and pedestrians

interpretation: Subsection 3 is read in the section backing context. The stem itself identifies the obligated driver; it does not supply another hidden activation clause. This is a source review of scope, not a legal outcome finding.
pedestrian_disposition: Required statutory alternative; not represented by existing selected other-vehicle timing pair. Needs distinct executable pedestrian cases and comparison or documented source-backed reuse.
